levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reads the size tag or brand tag instead of the care tag, or misses the wash or drying symbol on more than one garment.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly locates the care tag and identifies the wash-temperature and drying symbols on all three garments.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly identifies wash, drying, and any special warning symbol on all three garments without help from the reference card by the last one.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Names a symbol but cannot match it to its meaning on the reference card without significant help.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly matches most identified symbols to their written meaning using the reference card.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly matches every identified symbol to its meaning and predicts a fourth garment's symbols before checking the card.

lookFors: The learner distinguishes the care tag from the size or brand tag by name, not just by pointing.
The reflection response names a specific garment and a specific instruction, not a general 'tags were confusing' statement.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
